item.title: Olivia Colman and John Lithgow star 'Jimpa,' new queer family drama
item.description: Three generations, one city and a whole lot of heart. Stars Olivia Colman and John Lithgow tell "important message" behind their new film, "Jimpa."

item.title: North suburban high school dance team now back-to-back state champions
item.description: The Lake Park High School Lancettes are officially back-to-back state champions, taking home the Illinois High School Association State Dance title over the weekend.

item.title: Building management gave consent for immigration raid at South Shore apartment complex: Court docs
item.description: Newly filed court documents for someone detained in the immigration raid of a South Side apartment complex reveal the building's owner or manager gave verbal and written consent for the raid.

item.title: Teens accused in downtown Macy's burglary, drawing map to hide in store after it closed: Sheriff
item.description: Two teens are accused in a downtown Chicago Macy's burglary by hiding in the Loop store after it closed to steal merchandise. The sheriff's department says the pair had even drawn a map of the store.

item.title: 2 shot, 1 fatally, in vehicle on South Side, baby unharmed in back seat, Chicago police say
item.description: A woman died after two people were shot in their vehicle on Chicago's South Side Wednesday afternoon before crashing, Chicago police said. A baby in the back seat of the victims' vehicle was unharmed.

item.title: Police investigating incident at Waukegan club; man says he was wrongly accused, thrown to ground
item.description: Managers at Red Iguana nightclub say the security guard involved was immediately fired after the incident, saying they are standing by the victim who was left battered after being thrown out over what the victim says was a smoking policy.

item.title: West Side community members express concerns over plans to redevelop closed Mars-Wrigley factory
item.description: Neighbors in a neighborhood on Chicago's West Side say they want their community needs reflected in the plans to redevelop the now closed Mars-Wrigley chocolate factory. They would like to see a new library, retail and a job training center.

item.title: Man killed in rollover crash on I-294 near Des Plaines identified by officials
item.description: A person who was killed in a multi-vehicle rollover crash Wednesday evening on I-294 in the north suburbs has been identified as a 69-year-old man.

item.title: Facebook, Instagram pages disabled after being wrongly accused of 'child endangerment,' owners say
item.description: In cases the ABC7 I-Team looked into, social media account holders said that they were wrongly accused of "child endangerment" and their Facebook and or Instagram pages disappeared.

item.title: Supreme Court allows new California congressional districts that favor Democrats
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday allowed California to use a new voter-approved congressional map that is favorable to Democrats in this year's elections, rejecting a last-ditch plea from state Republicans and the Trump administration.
